concept.definition: A \"Discharge to Assess\" (D2A) plan. D2A is a model whereby people with new or additional health and/or social care needs on discharge receive post-discharge recovery support, and where assessments of longer-term or ongoing needs (if required) are fully completed only once a person has reached a point of recovery and stability.
